pre-commit.description: Off by default in Renovate; bumps the hook `rev:` pins in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

customManagers.description: The pinned gitleaks release the CI history scan downloads
The WLED release tag fleet/build.sh asserts before building the fleet firmware, and the checkout commands and paths that name it in build.sh and the READMEs: one MR moves every site.
The Renovate release the config validator in CI runs; the app runs Renovate's latest, so this follows it.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates merge themselves once the branch is green and up to date with main, after the 3-day minimumReleaseAge, as in tycstation's shared preset. Majors and digest refreshes stay PRs. platformAutomerge is off so Renovate merges only a green, up-to-date branch itself instead of arming GitHub auto-merge.
A WLED bump changes the firmware flashed to the lamps and the effect ids the fleet configs were checked against (glorb_fx), so it is reviewed and re-verified, never automerged.
